title: CMA Application Configuration
description: Schema for CMA application branding settings (app.json)

logo.description: Path to company logo image (relative to site root)

url.description: URL to link the logo to (e.g. company website)

backgroundColor.description: Background color for logo area (CSS color value)

maintenance.description: Branding for the deploy maintenance page (maintenance.php). All optional; each falls back to 'company' or a built-in default.

logo.description: Path to the logo shown on the maintenance page (relative to site root, or an absolute URL). Usually the public/webshop logo, not the CMA admin logo.

name.description: Site/company name (used in the page title and logo alt text)

message.description: Headline shown to visitors while a deploy runs

whatsapp.description: WhatsApp number in international digits (e.g. 316...); rendered as a wa.me link for visitors stuck >10 min

email.description: Contact e-mail rendered as a mailto link

accent.description: Accent colour for links/dot (CSS color value); falls back to company.backgroundColor
